purpose: Re-audit the three-session research frontier after the terminal free-float-scarcity uniqueness result and select at most one economically independent, reproducible public-data mechanism without reusing a terminal provider branch or reading a new price or return.

candidate_review.reason: The terminal gross-margin branch already used the same standard fina_indicator per-stock history route and failed its only full-source attempt on an incomplete required identity, announcement-date, report-period, or version field. Changing only the financial metric would be a high-probability replay of the same source failure and is not authorized as a field sweep.

The frontier already completed and terminally rejected restricted-share unlock pressure after full source, capacity, association, and Top-3 gates. Replacing the provider or moving from realized unlock date to schedule announcement does not create a sufficiently independent supply mechanism for this iteration.

Premium, turnover, event count, and freshness from the same block-trade family have already been tested and terminally failed. Adding buyer or seller identity transforms after those outcomes would be a same-family field sweep rather than a new preregistered mechanism.

Two post-cooldown anonymous login probes were rejected as a blacklisted user, and the current-session follow-up explicitly forbids another probe or bulk retry without a verifiable provider-state change or guidance.

The public full-market balance-sheet report partitions by quarter, exposes report and announcement dates plus total assets and total liabilities, and is fetched in hundreds rather than thousands of calls. Issuer leverage is economically distinct from price path, valuation, trading flow, ownership scarcity, event counts, analyst activity, and the existing profitability-growth eligibility gate.

public_adapter_evidence.pre_request_locator_correction: Before any Eastmoney provider row was requested, source verification found that stock_yjbb_em.py contains only the earnings-report adapter. The locator was corrected to the actual stock_zcfz_em implementation in stock_report_em.py at the same pinned commit; the endpoint, report, request parameters, five raw positions, formula, direction, timing, and every downstream gate remained unchanged.

selected_candidate.economic_mechanism: Among already profitable and growing issuers, a larger asset cushion relative to liabilities may reduce balance-sheet fragility and forced financing risk over a three-session holding horizon.
selected_candidate.units: dimensionless equity-funded asset share before accounting presentation differences
selected_candidate.valid_row: stock code, report date, announcement date, total assets, and total liabilities are complete; total assets is finite and strictly positive; total liabilities is finite and nonnegative; total liabilities does not exceed total assets
selected_candidate.invalid_row_policy: exclude and count without clipping, filling, sign changes, field substitution, or inference
selected_candidate.availability: first local trading session strictly after the source announcement date
selected_candidate.quality_gate: ROE at least 5 percent, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY under the existing next-session point-in-time policy

economic_independence.versus_existing_quarterly_quality: The existing quarterly source supplies ROE, net profit sign, revenue growth, profit growth, and their accelerations. It contains no asset, liability, leverage, liquidity, or solvency field. The four existing values remain eligibility gates and cannot be reweighted into this factor.
economic_independence.versus_tushare_cash_conversion: Cash conversion compared operating cash flow with attributable profit and stopped at its own full-source statement-version gate. Balance-sheet resilience uses neither cash flow nor income and does not reuse the deleted Tushare partial source.
economic_independence.versus_gross_margin: Gross-margin change is an operating profitability disclosure event from a different metric and a terminal per-stock Tushare route. The selected factor is a carried balance-sheet state from a full-market quarterly report.
economic_independence.versus_pb_and_free_float_scarcity: No price, book-to-market valuation, share count, market capitalization, or ownership field enters the formula.
economic_independence.versus_price_volume_and_event_factors: No OHLCV, turnover, order flow, analyst, billboard, block-trade, pledge, holder, repurchase, unlock, or management field enters the formula.

future_uniqueness_framework_fix.reason: The terminal free-float audit showed that requiring every dense candidate to accumulate 100 pairwise sessions against sparse event fields can reject a factor for missing overlap rather than synonym evidence.
future_uniqueness_framework_fix.scope: This rule is frozen only for new hypotheses after the free-float terminal result and may not reopen or reinterpret that result.
future_uniqueness_framework_fix.dense_statistical_catalog_policy: Only comparison fields already proven to have at least 100 eligible daily pairwise sessions enter the mandatory absolute-median Spearman gate.
future_uniqueness_framework_fix.sparse_event_policy: Previously proven sparse comparison fields remain in an explicit economic-mechanism review, are reported descriptively when overlap exists, and cannot cause a statistical pass or fail without the preregistered minimum sessions.
future_uniqueness_framework_fix.anti_cherry_pick_rule: The dense and sparse catalogs must be enumerated in the data contract before any new source row or factor value and cannot be changed after acceptance, capacity, or correlation results.

required_gate_order: freeze the exact provider report, pinned adapter evidence, source positions, report dates, factor formula, direction, timing, invalid-row, completeness, atomicity, capacity, and uniqueness rules before any new balance-sheet row
implement and locally test count-complete pagination, positional schema rejection, formula derivation, atomic publication, and one-shot cross-clone guards
run one fixed 2025-12-31 no-price source acceptance and permanently consume it
only after acceptance, run one atomic 2019-2025 quarterly full-source snapshot
run the fixed dense-state 200-cohort five-year capacity gate without comparison fields or prices
only after capacity passes, run the preregistered dense uniqueness catalog and sparse mechanism review without forward returns
freeze a separate one-time return and execution diagnostic only if every no-return gate passes
prohibited_actions: request or persist price, market-capitalization, valuation, precomputed return, forward return, security name, receivables, inventory, payables, cash, or equity fields as factor inputs
replace the formula with debt growth, cash-to-debt, current ratio, quick ratio, working capital, goodwill, leverage change, an industry residual, or a financial-sector exception after seeing rows
treat a missing or invalid source row as zero leverage or perfect resilience
use same-day announcement trading, a shorter or longer carry age, a reversed direction, a different report range, or a lower capacity threshold
reopen the terminal free-float branch under the revised future uniqueness framework
read returns, aggregate, score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before all no-return gates pass
